name: DaFang AI DF062 wall finishing robot
summary: Wheeled four-in-one wall robot that grinds, plasters or skims, sands and paints interior walls up to 6 m high, mapping the room with lidar and run from an Android app. On the Hong Kong CITF pre-approved list as PA23-051.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU seller found. DaFang AI (Singapore, Hong Kong and a factory in Dongguan) takes enquiries at marketing@dafang.ai; its site shows customer reviews from Italy and Russia.

specs.label: Maximum construction height
specs.quote: The maximum construction height is 6 meters.

specs.label: Functions
specs.value: Grinding, plastering, skimming, painting and sanding
specs.quote: The DF062 wall finishing robot combines functions of grinding, plastering, skimming, painting and sanding.

specs.label: Runtime per battery
specs.quote: It runs about 5 hours per battery

specs.label: Control
specs.quote: controlled from an Android phone or tablet

notes: Works the wall from a module on a lift and arm; the crew swaps the module for each process.
Skimming and sanding stop at 5.25 m according to Robots in Construction.
Uses lidar and IMU SLAM to map the room.

images.alt: DaFang AI DF062 wall finishing robot, picture from dafang.ai

evidence.task: Grinds, skims, sands and sprays walls on building projects
evidence.note: Used at Yangjiang Country Garden by July 2023; Robots in Construction counts 7 deployments. The maker also lists cases in Shenzhen, Zhuhai and Dongguan.
